brief.text: Real estate and medical equipment providers dominate today's activity, with REITs STWD, NXRT, and HPP alongside medical device makers NXGL, ENOV, and OBIO all drawing cluster purchases. Six Flags Entertainment (FUN) recorded the largest total commitment at $24,312,320 across three insiders, while Starwood Property Trust (STWD) saw the biggest individual transaction—a $14,697,682 purchase by CEO Barry Sternlicht. General American Investors (GAM) showed the widest internal consensus, leading all groups with five separate insiders acquiring shares.
